Perfect! All 83 tests pass. Added:

✅ **src/render.js** — `renderInvoiceText(invoice)` returns a plain-text invoice with:
- First line: invoice number (or "DRAFT" if unpublished)
- Second line: customer name
- Line items: "Nqty x Product name @ €unitPrice = €lineTotal"
- Last line: "Total: €amount"
- All amounts formatted via formatEuros() with thousands separators and two decimals

✅ **12 comprehensive tests** covering draft/issued invoices, single/multiple items, large quantities, small amounts, VAT-exempt products, different customers, format consistency, and immutability
